articles.summary: Q4 total sales grew 11%, and comparable store sales increased 4% Q4 net income was $310 million, and diluted EPS was $4.84 FY25 total sales grew 9%, and comparable store sales increased 2% FY25 net income was $610 million, and diluted EPS was $9.51 Excluding expenses associated with bankruptcy
articles.title: Burlington Stores, Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings
